description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [HP Stock (6000)], [Regenga], [ATK, MAG and MND +30%], [Last Stand], [High Quick Cast 2], and [Natural Cure: Deuce] to all allies, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], and [Zenith Mode: Deuce] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Deuce
description.text: Cast speed x1.10 for White Magic or Bard abilities, White Magic or Bard abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Deuce after using a White Magic or Bard ability, maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Hymn of Healing
description.text: Restores 1000 HP, grants [Hymn of Healing ATK and MAG +5%/10%/20%/30%], grants [Performance 1/2/3/3] to the user if the user has Performance 0/1/2/3

description.name: HP Stock (6000)
description.text: Automatically restores HP, up to 6000 HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering

description.name: Natural Cure: Deuce
description.text: Grants [HP Stock (3000)] when HP fall below 20%, removed after triggering

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
